description:
The Creative X team within Amazon Advertising builds AI systems that understand and evaluate ad images and videos, so advertisers of every size can deliver high-quality experiences to customers. In this role, you will build image and video models that recognize what a creative contains, check whether it meets quality and brand requirements, and measure its effectiveness with measurable precision and recall.

We invest in computer vision, video understanding, vision-language models (VLMs), multimodal representation learning, and evaluation science, including calibrating automated judges against human judgment. A central challenge is making these models work at scale: you will use techniques such as model distillation so that image and video understanding can run across billions of ad impressions. You will join a team of applied scientists, product managers and software developers, own science components from prototype to production, ship advertiser-facing features, and contribute to publications.

Key job responsibilities
- Build and improve image and video understanding models that extract semantic metadata from ad creatives, such as objects, products, scenes, text overlays, logos and brand elements, and shot-level events in video.
- Develop models and metrics that detect visual production defects (for example distorted products, garbled text, and temporal artifacts in video) and check whether creatives follow the brief, with measurable precision and recall.
- Apply methods through methods like distillation (and other techniques) to make efficient image and video understanding models, that are ready for production and can run at the scale of billions of daily ad impressions.
- Calibrate automated image and video judges against human annotations, using preference learning and active learning to raise agreement with expert reviewers.
- Run experiments, analyze the results, and turn findings into production improvements together with engineering and product partners. Share results in design reviews, documents and research publications.

About the team
The Creative X team within Amazon Advertising is on a mission to democratize access to high-quality ad creatives for advertisers worldwide. We build the AI systems that determine what a creative contains; whether and why it will resonate with customers, working across images, video, audio, and text at Amazon-scale volume; and then serve the most performative ads to customers based on their personas. If you are excited about pushing the boundaries of applied AI in a space where your models directly influence the advertising experience for millions of customers, we would love to hear from you.
- 3+ years of building models for business application experience
- Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing
- Experience in professional software development
- Knowledge of standard speech and machine learning techniques
